name: u_robinpolymono
notes: Use exactly the documented dynamic voice class and creation args8 s_drumelectro a b c d. Each bd triggers an independent real bass-drum voice via the round-robin senders. s_drumelectro has only inlet0 and outlet0, so dynamic connection to its inlet1 fails; shared inlet1 stimulation intentionally cannot affect this selected voice. Expected diagnostic: connection failed (missing s_drumelectro inlet1); the mono audio outlet still works. Help documents arity-related console errors.
